svg.aria-label: The basement as it might be finished, an axonometric view
svg.title: The basement as it might be finished, an axonometric view
svg.text: Drawing 3 of 3 · an axonometric view built from drawing 2 · walls cut at 3′-6″, the two near walls shown as outlines
drawn by Claude, from a sketch supplied by Bowie Smith
no furniture; only the floor finishes are imagined: wood, carpet in the office, tile in the bath, concrete in the closets
